speaker: Doctor
text: I see; to better understand your dizziness, nausea, and imbalance, can you tell me if these symptoms started suddenly or developed gradually? Have you noticed any hearing changes, such as ringing in your ears or muffled sound? Also, have you experienced any difficulty walking or feeling like the room is spinning around you?

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. He mentions recent increased intake of garlic due to trying to recover from a cold a few days ago. Past medical history is unremarkable.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; given your age and the nature of the spinning sensation, have you noticed any new hearing loss, ear fullness, or tinnitus since this morning began? speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sustained sensation of the room spinning. I also have Occasional nausea, Use of diphenhydramine for symptoms and to aid sleep, Recent cold.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) secondary to recent viral upper respiratory infection.
